# Quick QC and basic workflow
sp.obj <- SCTransform(sp.obj, assay = "Spatial", verbose = FALSE)   # or NormalizeData + FindVariableFeatures
sp.obj <- RunPCA(sp.obj, verbose = FALSE)
sp.obj <- RunUMAP(sp.obj, dims = 1:30)
sp.obj <- FindNeighbors(sp.obj, dims = 1:30)
sp.obj <- FindClusters(sp.obj, resolution = 0.4)

# Plot spatial feature or cluster
SpatialFeaturePlot(sp.obj, features = "nCount_Spatial")       # example
SpatialDimPlot(sp.obj, label = TRUE)
